visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige oversized shirt and white shorts, stands in a brightly lit exhibition hall. She looks with wide eyes and an open mouth at a sleek, teal-colored PC case designed like a futuristic vehicle, featuring vibrant RGB light strips and a built-in screen showing temperatures. (2) The scene cuts to a case that resembles a traditional golden mountain or fountain. Gold-colored liquid flows through pipes into a large golden bowl (Yuanbao) at the base, while the woman points towards the intricate liquid-cooled mechanism with a surprised smile. (3) The woman is shown with both hands on her cheeks, expressing shock and excitement. She is looking at a PC case containing a yellowish-green liquid tank where a creature resembling an Alien facehugger is submerged, surrounded by yellow neon lights. (4) A white PC case is displayed, featuring an elegant, palace-like archway design with a glowing fan inside. The woman stands beside it, gesturing towards the intricate details of the case's facade which looks like a cathedral or European building. (5) Next, she stands next to a tall black PC case that has a large, detailed 3D model of an Alien Xenomorph head mounted on the side panel. She waves her hand excitedly toward the camera while the green lights inside the case flicker. (6) The camera zooms in on a circular, white-framed PC case. Inside, a small astronaut figurine sits among the computer components under a bright white light. The woman’s face is partially visible as she peers into the case with a grin. (7) A PC case with anime artwork from Frieren is shown on a shelf. The woman poses by the case, holding her hair up to mimic rabbit ears while smiling broadly at the lens, showing the character art on the side panel. (8) She is seen in a wide shot, standing in front of a case shaped like a heavy-duty, sci-fi military tank or armored vehicle. She places her hands on her face in a shocked pose as she looks at the massive gray structure with glowing blue lights. (9) The focus shifts to a steampunk-themed PC case with brass tubes, gears, and glowing vacuum-tube-style displays. The woman leans in and points at the detailed copper craftsmanship of the case which looks like an antique engine. (10) She stands next to a tall, cylindrical white case with a transparent window. Inside, another astronaut figurine is placed near the liquid cooling reservoir. She waves enthusiastically to the viewers while the interior fan spins with white LEDs. (11) The woman leans on a glass display case containing a PC with a large, stylized red DOOM logo etched on the side. She looks at the camera with a curious, impressed expression, her head tilted slightly as she observes the red internal lighting. (12) She points toward an open-air PC built into a silver metal briefcase. The internal cooling system features bright pink and blue reservoirs with glowing fans, creating a high-contrast neon aesthetic within the metallic shell. (13) A blue, cage-like open-frame PC case is shown. The woman stands behind it, looking surprised and pointing at the exposed hardware components and the glowing red liquid within the cooling tubes. (14) In the final scene, she gestures towards a complex, gold-colored mechanical PC case that looks like a miniature scientific instrument or a robotic workstation, complete with multiple articulated arms and internal display screens.
